name: wonder-jump
description: Wonder Jump – Adventure Worlds: cute 2.5D 3D-chibi platformer for Android (TypeScript monorepo)

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @wonderjump/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @wonderjump/client
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build && npm run sync -w @wonderjump/mobile
